title: Reveal and operate the app card actions
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Choose an app action without triggering it accidentally.

**Expected behaviour** · Reveal after about one second of continuous hover or immediate deliberate click, tap, Enter or Space. Order actions Run, Open, More below the brief. Keyboard reveal focuses Run when settled.

**Scope boundary** · Run explains v0.2 availability. Open visits the overview. More offers Browse files.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-033

**Depends on** · WI-030, WI-032, WI-033

**Verify** · Test quick pass, timer cancellation, a separate activation, held Enter, Escape and Back to the originating action.

**Effort basis** · Cross-input state and focus timing.
